title: Japanese Teriyaki Chicken Skewers
description: Sweet and savory Japanese-style chicken skewers, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken legs, cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.amount: 10-12 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
ingredients.notes: If using wooden skewers, soak in water for 30 minutes before grilling

ingredients.name: green onions
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup thinly sliced green onions, for garnish

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together teriyaki sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and grated ginger.
3. Add chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the chicken is cooked through.
7. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
9. Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
10. Serve with steamed rice and your favorite sides.
